text:
diana: quick follow-up from the postmortem — evening batch overlap led to autoscaler thrash and temporary GPU exhaustion. need owners for quota backstop, scheduler tweak, and headroom/runway alerts.

lee: I can own the quota backstop. plan: soft reserve per-pool (default 10%), alert at 85%, page at 92% sustained 5m. ETA: 5 business days.

omar: i'll take scheduler tuning. immediate: reduce packing aggressiveness for batch jobs and add a 30s damp window to avoid repack thrash. will run a 7-day arrival trace sim and post p50/p95/p99.

diana: thanks. infra, can you expose pool.reserved_pct and pool.avg_mem_frac(1m) to support the acceptance tests and dashboard?

infra: yes — adding metrics and a small API field `/pools/:id` -> desired_headroom_pct + reserved_pct. PR by EOD tom.

lee: acceptance test snippet for quota backstop:
```
# acceptance
ramp(batch_qps=4x, duration=900s)
assert(reserved_pct(interactive) >= 10%)
expect(alert='quota_soft', within=90s)
expect(pager='quota_hard', if=sustained(>92%, 300s))
```

omar: scheduler change: propose new eviction score: `score = mem_frac*1.5 + cpu_frac*0.6 + age_secs*0.0008` and `evict_damp_ms = 30000`. staging sim first.

diana: please include pack/unpack latency and token-cost delta in the sim results. we need to know cost impact.

infra: note — we can add a synthetic metric predicted_runway_minutes (linear & ar2) to metrics. we'll wire linear forecast first and mark model output experimental.

lee: for the runway alert short-circuit: if predicted_runway_minutes < 30 and sustained growth_rate > 4%/m then trigger preemptive scale + page with 15m cooldown.

omar: will run chaos tests too: inject a spot preempt and measure repack latency. snippet: 
```
kill_gpu(node='spot-12')
measure(pack_latency, tail_latency)
```

diana: ops-bot, file remediation tickets and assign owners.

sre-bot: Created remediations: REM-9201 (quota-backstop) assigned to lee, REM-9202 (scheduler-damp) assigned to omar, REM-9203 (runway-metric) assigned to infra. due dates: 2024-07-16, 2024-07-18, 2024-07-15.

lee: i'll add the acceptance tests to CI gating so merges only go green if tests pass.

omar: blocker: need historical per-job mem_frac histograms for past 30 days to tune eviction weight. @infra can you backfill?

infra: scheduled backfill; ETA ~3h. will post when complete.

diana: ownership recap: lee -> REM-9201 quota backstop (5d), omar -> REM-9202 scheduler tuning + sims (7d), infra -> REM-9203 runway metric + ops card (3d). i'll add these to the postmortem follow-ups section and schedule a 72h check-in.

lee: small UX note: quota backstop should spill background batch to a delayed queue instead of outright rejecting when hard threshold hits. i'll implement a queue shim.

omar: i'll share sim numbers in 48h and include p50/p95/p99 for interactive and batch plus cost delta.

sre-bot: Linked postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1765556666

diana: thanks all — reconvene in 3 business days to review. ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:
